title: Pathway Declaration & Capstone Build
description: Week 7: decide with evidence, then package the proof. Participants evaluate fit for each pathway using rotation performance, reflections, interview intelligence, and coach input, justifying the choice in writing; synthesize eight weeks of pipeline data into a metrics story, creating a Personal Prospecting Playbook and assembling best artifacts from each rotation into the Outreach Portfolio capstone; and submit an apprenticeship application for the declared pathway citing portfolio evidence, updating resume and LinkedIn with real results. Weekly milestone: pathway declared; capstone draft complete; apprenticeship application submitted.
notes: Weekly milestone: pathway declared; capstone draft complete; apprenticeship application submitted.
lesson_length: Lab-guide lessons, roughly 1200-1800 words each, supporting a full week of live instructor-led practice
learning_objectives: Evaluate pathway fit with evidence and justify the choice in writing
Synthesize pipeline data into a metrics story, playbook, and portfolio of best artifacts
Submit an apprenticeship application citing portfolio evidence, with updated resume and LinkedIn

lessons.title: Pathway Decision
objectives: Evaluate pathway fit with evidence and justify the choice in writing
Weigh rotation performance, reflections, interview intelligence, and coach input

lessons.title: The Outreach Portfolio (Capstone)
objectives: Synthesize pipeline data into a metrics story, playbook, and portfolio of best artifacts
Assemble a Personal Prospecting Playbook and best artifacts from each rotation

lessons.title: Apprenticeship Application
objectives: Submit an apprenticeship application citing portfolio evidence, with updated resume and LinkedIn
Convert program outcomes into concrete, quantified statements a recruiter can verify

sequencing_rationale: Week 7: decide with evidence, then package the proof. Pathway decision first because the capstone and application both depend on the declared pathway; the Outreach Portfolio capstone second as the week's project; the apprenticeship application last because it cites the portfolio. Scope assumption: the decision framework weighs rotation performance, reflections, interview intelligence, and coach input — enthusiasm alone is explicitly insufficient.
